'''AK-1A "Hammer"''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[HK-47]] in his attempts to take over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and an arsenal of missiles. It was destroyed by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who went on to defeat HK-47.
